title: OrgChart
description: Declarative agent org chart (issue #632, workbook-1; EPIC #631 Pillar 2 'Org Chart for Agents'; source workbook rows issue #614 Tab 1). It declares the five C-suite roles, their reporting edges, the single root and the per-role FinOps/heartbeat governance the platform enforces. Every edge must reference a persona that actually resolves in registry/personas/cards/, so the org chart can never drift from the persona library: registry/personas/registry.py validate_org_chart() fails an unresolvable edge or a second root. The declaration is data — a tenant extends the chart by adding its own org-chart.yaml; the schema and the validator are shared.

orgChartSchema.description: Schema tag for this declaration (mirrors the persona-manifest/v1 ledger tag). A reader refuses a chart whose tag it does not know.

tenant.description: The tenant that owns this org chart. 'platform' is the platform-default chart; any other value is a tenant chart (same tenancy rule as persona cards).

principal.description: The principal OUTSIDE the agent org at its head — the reporting target of the single root role. It is deliberately NOT a persona: the board is a human principal, so it cannot be dispatched and must not resolve to a card.

root.description: The single root role id of the org chart (e.g. ceo). Exactly one role may declare reportsTo: board, and that role must be this one; registry.validate_org_chart() refuses a second root or a root that is not the declared one.

roles.description: The roles of the org chart, one per node. Each entry binds a persona id to its reporting edge and its governance (tier, monthly cap, heartbeat).

id.description: The persona id this node binds (must equal a resolvable platform persona id, and the card's reportsTo must agree with this edge).

title.description: Human-readable role title from the workbook row (e.g. 'Executive Strategy Director').

reportsTo.description: The reporting target of this edge: either the chart principal ('board', allowed only for the root role) or another persona id that must itself be a node in this chart AND resolve as a platform persona. An unresolvable edge is refused.

defaultModelTier.description: Closed platform tier for this role (must agree with the bound card's defaultModelTier).

monthlyBudgetCapUsd.description: Monthly budget cap in USD for this role (must agree with the bound card's monthlyBudgetCapUsd). A negative cap is refused.

heartbeatSchedule.description: Heartbeat cadence for this role (must agree with the bound card's heartbeatSchedule).
